faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Banda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Banda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Reader, 2 Ahlmad, 1 Peon.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Banda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Special Judge, Special Court No.-01 (Prevention of Corruption Act), Banda, by submitted at the office of the undersigned, to reach by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 6750 प्रतिमाह (per month) for Reader, 6750 प्रतिमाह (per month) for Ahlmad, 150 प्रतिदिन (per day) for Peon.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open only to retired employees of the District Court, Banda and the Collectorate, Banda; the notice prints no educational qualification. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired employees of District Court, Banda and Collectorate, Banda may apply. Application must be written in the applicant's own handwriting.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Non-retired employees. Employees older than 65 years.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Court of Special Judicial Magistrate-I, Banda.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notification describes the engagement as: Contract.
